results.title: Idaho Fish and Game Commissioner Brody Harshbarger resigns following plea agreement
results.description: Embattled Idaho Fish and Game Commissioner Brody Harshbarger has resigned from the commission after agreeing to plead guilty to misdemeanor hunting charges, state records show.

results.description: With the sun about to set on her Channel 7 contract, the nation’s most glamorous prime time TV anchor Sonia Kruger could soon be in the market for a new gig.

results.title: 3 District 5 administrators earn statewide recognition
results.description: Chapin High School Principal Ed Davis, Lake Murray Elementary School Principal Kristen Eubanks and Crossroads Middle School Assistant Principal Samonja Holland have earned statewide honors from the South Carolina Association of School Administrators.

results.title: Okotoks RCMP invite community to help cram a cruiser full of holiday cheer for families in need
results.description: Okotoks RCMP are inviting the community to help cram their cruisers full of groceries, essentials and toys in support of the Okotoks Food Bank Friday night.

results.title: Kenyan marathon champion banned for doping
results.description: In tonight's edition, Kenyan athletics superstar and reigning marathon world champion Peres Jepchirchir is banned for three years for doping. Also, South African judges leave the courtroom behind and tour a repatriation centre before handing down judgment in 33 emergency asylum applications. And Ghana's presidency has a new jet, but critics of the ruling party are not on board.

results.title: Jon Hamm, 55, and wife Anna Osceola, 38, welcome their first baby together
results.description: The actor and his partner, who met on the "Mad Men" set, got married in June 2023. News broke over the summer that they were expecting.

results.title: Kouchan Ramen first US location in Plano to open Dec. 1
results.description: Kouchan Ramen will celebrate its grand opening Dec. 7 at its first US location in Plano, offering Hakata-style ramen with in-house broth and noodles.
